caption:
The circle equation is secretly Pythagoras.

From the center (2, −1) to any point on the circle, the legs are x − 2 and y + 1 and the hypotenuse is the radius: (x − 2)² + (y + 1)² = 25.

Save this so you never forget it.
tiktok_caption: The circle equation is just the Pythagorean theorem.
